howItWorks.title: Three Steps to Your Outdoor Adventure
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple process, from discovery to departure in as fast as 5 minutes
howItWorks.discoverDesc: Browse curated destinations, from cafes to parks, mountains to coastlines. Check route details and the best season to find your next getaway
howItWorks.findTeamDesc: Filter recruiting teams by location and see who's waiting for you. Check leader info and team composition, apply to join like-minded groups
howItWorks.departDesc: Once approved, coordinate a meeting time with your teammates, grab your backpack, and go. Or create your own team and lead companions where you want to go
